name: fans
description:
This is the website created for the assignment provided by the Atomberg.
In this, the user has to input the api and refresh token from its Atomberg Home App.

Prerequisites
1. Node.js
2. Vite
3. Tailwind CSS
4. Atomberg Home App

How to run the app
1. Clone the repo
    git clone https://github.com/UTKARSHJHA-2005/ATOMBERG-WEB.git

2. Install the dependencies
    cd ATOMBERG-WEB
    npm install
3. Run the app (for Vite)
    npm run dev
Run the app (for node)
    node ./src/index.js

4. The Vite server will start at localhost:5173 and
index.js one will show
